Function Documentation

HxResult HxNetConnect ( HxNetConnectPolicy_t  policy  ) 

Establish a network connection.

This function shows up a dialog with the buttons for enabled network interfaces (e.g. "WiFi", "Bluetooth") so that users can establish a network connection with the interface. The dialog also include the button to go to the connection preference panel to set up a new interface.

Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
